notes.title: New release soon!
notes.notes:
Featuring:
[list]
[*] Import your own custom walls and objects to paint on (.obj)
[*] New way to project reference images onto walls
[*] Tons of bug fixes
[/list]
Players will be able to design custom walls and objects to paint on using Blender or other 3D programs. If anyone wants to help test this out before release contact me at vivespray@gmail.com

notes.title: Update #4: New tools, workflow improvements, foot tracking, reference image improvements and Windows Mixed Reality support
notes.notes:
[h1]Windows Mixed Reality Support[/h1]
Windows Mixed Reality is now fully supported.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29516240/4814a2255999bcddf281faf20d84e3e84fbb773a.png[/img]

[h1]Spline Spray Tool[/h1]
Lovely outlines for toys using splines.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HhCTg4o.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8EgLXCY.gif[/img]

[h1]Improved reference image tool[/h1]
Load in as many reference images as you like. Scale and position them onto the wall. Once positioned tweak their transparency and spray through them onto the wall. A special cut-off setting allows you to completely hide non-black portions of your reference - really handy if you only want the outline of your reference to be visible. Spray into the sky to toggle the visibility of all reference images.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jhLjCrb.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hmQQ19X.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KpXqwx8.gif[/img]

[h1]Foot Tracking[/h1]
Foot tracking with Vive trackers.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xXrRcgc.gif[/img]

[h1]Zoomable smartcam[/h1]
Click anywhere in the ViveSpray 2 window to enable smart cam. Control zoom with W and S keys. Foot tracking looks great from this view.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zAKKOI6.gif[/img]

notes.title: Massive update and leaving early access.
notes.notes:
The new update is now live and ViveSpray 2 has left early access.

Here's a recap of what's in the update:

Stencils were one of the most requested features so I'm happy to announce a new stencil system as part of the update. The system supports custom stencil images. This is a very versatile and powerful feature that opens up a whole range of possibilities. The stencil system works in conjunction with ViveSprays masking system, which has been improved further with the addition of several new advanced masking features along with the ability to store and recall multiple masks at any time.

For an overview visit the [url=http://vivespray.surge.sh]ViveSpray 2 Website[/url].
[list]
    [*] New strreet environment
    [*] Stencils (custom stencil images supported)
    [*] Advanced masking (mask paint, save and restore mask)
    [*] Third person spectator camera (click anywhere in window to activate)
    [*] Reworked controls for Rift and Vive
    [*] Option to rotate playspace
    [*] Improvements to online wall, less bandwidth and upload and download progress bars.
    [*] New cap dot pattern
    [*] Screenshot camera for online wall and local saves is now repositionable
    [*] Added wooden palettes to factory environment
    [*] Tons of bug fixes
[/list]

Thanks to everyone that provided feedback or help.

notes.title: Update: Online wall
notes.notes:
The online wall feature for the factory environment is now available in the default version of ViveSpray, no need to switch to the testing branch any more.

To try it out, go to the factory, you'll find the UI on the back wall between the large windows along with an explanation of how it works.

notes.title: Update: Masking and improved Rift support
notes.notes:
A new masking can has been added. You can use it to mask parts of the wall from being painted on. The mask can be inverted and cleared. It's a simple but very powerful tool and it's worth investing some time to get to grips with it.

Early Rift support has also been added and ViveSpray is now perfectly playable on Rift, however there will probably be further updates to make it more comfortable. Until then I recommend avoiding teleportation with the hand you're holding something in as it will be dropped. Instead just use your off-hand.
